stories.title: OHL suspends Kitchener’s Ryder Roberson 14 games for dangerous takedown during fight
stories.summary: TORONTO — The Ontario Hockey League suspended Kitchener Rangers player Ryder Roberson for 14 games Friday following an incident in Wednesday’s game against the Windsor Spitfires.

stories.title: Employer denies allegation nurse contract not being renewed over Poilievre photo
stories.summary: OTTAWA — The employer of a nurse who Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre says has been told her contract won’t be renewed over a photo with him says the allegations are false.

stories.title: Sam Bennett scores 200th career goal with 24 seconds left as Panthers beat Capitals 3-2
stories.summary: WASHINGTON (AP) — Sam Bennett scored with 24 seconds remaining, the 200th goal of his career, and the Florida Panthers rallied past the Washington Capitals 3-2 on Friday.

stories.title: Trail concludes, judge reserves decision in Steven Galloway's defamation lawsuit
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — The B.C. Supreme Court trial has concluded in author Steven Galloway's defamation lawsuit against the woman who accused him of rape, and other defendants, with the judge reserving her decision for a later date.

stories.title: Flyers beat Canucks 5-2 after leading scorer Matvei Michkov is benched for 'internal team matter'
stories.summary: PHILADELPHIA (AP) — Travis Konecny, Porter Martone and Tyson Foerster scored on the power play and the Flyers beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-2 Friday with Philadelphia leading scorer Matvei Michkov benched.

stories.title: Whitehorse Power Centres project referred to major projects office
stories.summary: WHITEHORSE — The federal government is referring the Whitehorse Power Centres to Canada's major projects office. Prime Minister Mark Carney announced the move Thursday at a meeting in Whitehorse with Yukon Premier Currie Dixon.

stories.title: Former B.C. minister, labour leader George Heyman dies
stories.summary: BURNABY — Former British Columbia environment minister and labour leader George Heyman has died at 77 years old. The BC General Employees' Union said in a release that Heyman died Friday morning, but it did not provide a cause of death.

stories.title: Inspired Steelers move on from Rodgers' exit with cathartic 27-5 win over sloppy Broncos
stories.summary: PITTSBURGH (AP) — T.J. Watt recovered a fumble by Bo Nix in the end zone for a touchdown, Jalen Ramsey intercepted Nix and returned it for a score, and the Pittsburgh Steelers emerged from a chaotic week by drilling the Denver Broncos 27-5 on Friday.

stories.title: Neither inflation nor bad weather deters Black Friday shoppers from seeking deals
stories.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Shoppers migrated from Thanksgiving meals to Black Friday deals as predictably as geese heading south for winter, with some pursuing discounts with help from artificial intelligence tools and others venturing to malls despite bad wea

stories.title: Senators top Lightning 6-2 in historic win for Linus Ullmark
stories.summary: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — Linus Ullmark stopped 18 shots, Michael Amadio had a goal and two assists, and Tim Stutzle scored twice as the Ottawa Senators defeated the Tampa Bay Lightning 6-2 on Friday.

stories.title: Break in weather comes just in time for Victoria's Santa Claus Parade
stories.summary: The 44th annual Santa Claus parade starts at 5:30 p.m. Saturday at Government and Belleville streets.

stories.title: ‘The definition of pain’: Parents reeling after B.C. assisted dying decision in court
